expected_answer: Full-time employees receive 18 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
An annual leave request must be submitted at least five working days before the planned leave begins. The employee's reporting manager must approve it before the leave is confirmed.
Full-time employees must serve a notice period of 30 calendar days when resigning.
Monthly salary is paid on the last working day of each month.
